PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_BossRetr.en: A strange pull draws you toward\nthe CHAMPION's hall, where the\lboss still waits.\pGo straight back to face him?\n(Your team will be healed.)
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_BossRetr.fr: Une étrange attraction t'entraîne\nvers la salle du CHAMPION, où le\lboss attend toujours.\pRetourner l'affronter directement ?\n(Ton équipe sera soignée.)

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder0In.en: COUNCIL OF ELDERS, 1 OF 20.\pBROCK: My defense is rock solid.\pShow me you can break it!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder0In.fr: CONSEIL DES ANCIENS, 1 SUR 20.\pBROCK : Ma défense est solide comme\nle roc.\pMontre-moi que tu peux la briser !{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder10I.en: COUNCIL OF ELDERS, 11 OF 20.\pLANCE: The dragons knew you would\ncome back.\pLet me see how far you have grown.{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder10I.fr: CONSEIL DES ANCIENS, 11 SUR 20.\pLANCE : Les dragons savaient que tu\nreviendrais.\pVoyons jusqu'où t'as\ngrandi.{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder11I.en: COUNCIL OF ELDERS, 12 OF 20.\pWILL: I saw your victory in dreams.\pLet me see if the dream was true.{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder11I.fr: CONSEIL DES ANCIENS, 12 SUR 20.\pWILL : J'ai vu ta victoire en rêve.\pVoyons si le rêve était\nvrai.{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder12I.en: COUNCIL OF ELDERS, 13 OF 20.\pKOGA: A ninja never loses twice.\pYet I will gladly lose to a\nworthy foe.{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder12I.fr: CONSEIL DES ANCIENS, 13 SUR 20.\pKOGA : Un ninja perd jamais deux\nfois.\pPourtant je perdrai volontiers face\nà un adversaire digne.{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder13I.en: COUNCIL OF ELDERS, 14 OF 20.\pKAREN: Strong POKéMON, weak\nPOKéMON... I do not care.\pOnly the bond matters.{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder13I.fr: CONSEIL DES ANCIENS, 14 SUR 20.\pKAREN : POKéMON forts, POKéMON\nfaibles… peu m'importe.\pSeul le lien compte.{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder14D.en: Ahaha! That was worth the trip!

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder14I.en: COUNCIL OF ELDERS, 15 OF 20.\pSIDNEY: Ahahaha! A CHAMPION!\pI came all this way for a good\nfight. Do not disappoint me!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder14I.fr: CONSEIL DES ANCIENS, 15 SUR 20.\pSIDNEY : Ahahaha ! Un CHAMPION !\pJe suis venu de loin pour un bon\ncombat. Me déçois pas !{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder15I.en: COUNCIL OF ELDERS, 16 OF 20.\pPHOEBE: The spirits whisper your\nname, CHAMPION.\pLet us listen together.{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder15I.fr: CONSEIL DES ANCIENS, 16 SUR 20.\pPHOEBE : Les esprits murmurent ton\nnom, CHAMPION.\pÉcoutons ensemble.{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder16I.en: COUNCIL OF ELDERS, 17 OF 20.\pGLACIA: I have waited a long time\nfor a fight that burns.\pMelt me, if you can.{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder16I.fr: CONSEIL DES ANCIENS, 17 SUR 20.\pGLACIA : J'ai attendu longtemps un\ncombat qui brûle.\pFais-moi fondre, si tu\npeux.{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder17I.en: COUNCIL OF ELDERS, 18 OF 20.\pDRAKE: A true TRAINER treats\nPOKéMON as equals.\pShow me that you do!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder17I.fr: CONSEIL DES ANCIENS, 18 SUR 20.\pDRAKE : Un vrai DRESSEUR traite les\nPOKéMON en égaux.\pMontre-moi que c'est ton cas !{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder18I.en: COUNCIL OF ELDERS, 19 OF 20.\pSTEVEN: I collect stones. And I\ncollect strong TRAINERS.\pYou belong in both collections.{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder18I.fr: CONSEIL DES ANCIENS, 19 SUR 20.\pSTEVEN : Je collectionne les\npierres. Et je collectionne les\pDRESSEURS forts.\pTu appartiens aux deux\ncollections.{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder19D.en: Splendid! You are a true MASTER.

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder19I.en: COUNCIL OF ELDERS, 20 OF 20.\pWALLACE: Beauty and strength, both.\pThe last of the old guard\nstands before you.{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder19I.fr: CONSEIL DES ANCIENS, 20 SUR 20.\pWALLACE : La beauté et la force,\nles deux.\pLe dernier de la vieille garde se\ntient devant toi.{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder1De.en: Wow! You are a real CHAMPION!

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder1In.en: COUNCIL OF ELDERS, 2 OF 20.\pMISTY: Water POKéMON are not\njust pretty!\pDive in, CHAMPION!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder1In.fr: CONSEIL DES ANCIENS, 2 SUR 20.\pMISTY : Les POKéMON EAU sont pas\njuste beaux !\pPlonge, CHAMPION !{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder2In.en: COUNCIL OF ELDERS, 3 OF 20.\pLT. SURGE: Hey, kid! I heard you\nbecame CHAMPION!\pLet me test that voltage!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder2In.fr: CONSEIL DES ANCIENS, 3 SUR 20.\pLT. BOB : Hé ! J'ai entendu que\ntu as décroché le titre de\lCHAMPION !\pLaisse-moi tester ce voltage !{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder3In.en: COUNCIL OF ELDERS, 4 OF 20.\pERIKA: Oh, hello. I was watering\nthe flowers.\pShall we have a gentle battle?{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder3In.fr: CONSEIL DES ANCIENS, 4 SUR 20.\pERIKA : Oh, bonjour. J'arrosais les\nfleurs.\pUn petit combat tranquille ?{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder4In.en: COUNCIL OF ELDERS, 5 OF 20.\pSABRINA: I foresaw this battle.\pI did not foresee how it ends.{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder4In.fr: CONSEIL DES ANCIENS, 5 SUR 20.\pSABRINA : J'avais prévu ce combat.\pJ'avais pas prévu sa\nfin.{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder5De.fr: Je me suis consumé… Bien combattu !

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder5In.en: COUNCIL OF ELDERS, 6 OF 20.\pBLAINE: Hah! My fire is still\nburning hot!\pLet us see if you can take it!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder5In.fr: CONSEIL DES ANCIENS, 6 SUR 20.\pBLAINE : Hah ! Mon feu brûle\ntoujours aussi fort !\pVoyons si tu peux le supporter !{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder6De.en: Hmph. The earth bows to you.

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder6In.en: COUNCIL OF ELDERS, 7 OF 20.\pGIOVANNI: ...The ground trembles\nbefore a true CHAMPION.\pI will not hold back.{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder6In.fr: CONSEIL DES ANCIENS, 7 SUR 20.\pGIOVANNI : …La terre tremble\ndevant un vrai CHAMPION.\pJe me retiendrai\npas.{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder7In.en: COUNCIL OF ELDERS, 8 OF 20.\pLORELEI: The ice has not melted\nsince you last came.\pShow me the CHAMPION's strength!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder7In.fr: CONSEIL DES ANCIENS, 8 SUR 20.\pLORELEI : La glace n'a pas fondu\ndepuis ta dernière visite.\pMontre-moi la force du CHAMPION !{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder8De.en: Hah! My training was not enough!

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder8In.en: COUNCIL OF ELDERS, 9 OF 20.\pBRUNO: Hoo! The CHAMPION returns!\pLet us see whose will is stronger!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder8In.fr: CONSEIL DES ANCIENS, 9 SUR 20.\pBRUNO : Hoo ! Le CHAMPION revient !\pVoyons quelle volonté est la plus\nforte !{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder9De.en: Oh, you old rascal.\nYou win again.

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder9In.en: COUNCIL OF ELDERS, 10 OF 20.\pAGATHA: Hee hee! Look at you, a\nCHAMPION.\pI have buried better TRAINERS!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Elder9In.fr: CONSEIL DES ANCIENS, 10 SUR 20.\pAGATHA : Hi hi ! Regarde-toi, un\nCHAMPION.\pJ'ai enterré de meilleurs DRESSEURS\n!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_ElderDon.en: The old guard has nothing more\nto teach you, CHAMPION.
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_ElderDon.fr: La vieille garde n'a plus rien à\nt'apprendre, CHAMPION.

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_ElderRew.en:
STEVEN: Some stones are older than
any LEAGUE. Your pendant is one.\pListen to it. It chose you for a
reason.\pAll 20 veterans bow to you.\pYou are the greatest of all
the CHAMPIONS!\pTake this, as proof of their
respect.
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_ElderRew.fr:
STEVEN : Certaines pierres sont
plus vieilles que toute LIGUE. Ton\lpendentif en est une.\pÉcoute-le. Il t'a choisi pour une
raison.\pLes 20 vétérans s'inclinent devant
toi.\pTu es le plus grand de tous les
CHAMPIONS !\pPrends ceci, en preuve de leur
respect.

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Interlud.en:
BROCK: Four of us have fallen.
The others watch from the hall.\pMISTY: Do you know why we
gathered? Years ago the AURA first\ltwisted the TYPES of POKéMON.\pERIKA: The GYMS noticed first.
The LEAGUE called it a rumor.\pSURGE: Rumors do not wake a whole
region. Something is calling.\pTake these, CHAMPION. You will need
them more than we do.
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Interlud.fr:
PIERRE : Quatre d'entre nous sont
tombés. Les autres regardent depuis\lla salle.\pMISTY : Tu sais pourquoi on s'est
réunis ? Il y a des années\ll'AURA a d'abord tordu les TYPES
des POKéMON.\pERIKA : Les ARÈNES l'ont remarqué
en premier. La LIGUE y a vu une\lrumeur.\pSURGE : Les rumeurs réveillent
pas toute une région. Quelque chose\lappelle.\pPrends ça, CHAMPION. T'en auras
plus besoin que nous.

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Interlud.en:
LORELEI: Four more. Let me tell you
what I felt in the ICEFALL CAVE.\pThe sea there remembers an echo.
A living memory of a POKéMON.\pSABRINA: I have seen them too.
Seven echoes, scattered across the\lSEVII ISLANDS.\pBLAINE: Three beasts, three golems,
and one that travels through time.\pGIOVANNI: Ask BILL on ONE ISLAND.
He has been listening for years.\pHere. A gift from the old guard.
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Interlud.fr:
LORELEI : Quatre de plus.
Laisse-moi te dire ce que j'ai\lressenti dans la GROTTE DE GLACE.\pLa mer s'y souvient d'un écho. Un
souvenir vivant d'un POKéMON.\pSABRINA : Je les ai vus aussi. Sept
échos, éparpillés dans les ÎLES\lSEVII.\pBLAINE : Trois bêtes, trois golems,
et un qui voyage dans le temps.\pGIOVANNI : Demande à LÉO sur l'ÎLE
1. Il écoute depuis des années.\pTiens. Un cadeau de la vieille
garde.

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Interlud.en:
LORELEI: Four more. The word has
reached us: you are closing the\lECHOES, one after another.\pSABRINA: I saw them in my visions
long before you set out.\pBLAINE: Beasts, golems, and one that
travels through time. Quite a hunt!\pGIOVANNI: BILL listened to them for
years. You are the one who answers.\pHere. A gift from the old guard.
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Interlud.fr:
LORELEI : Quatre de plus. La
nouvelle nous est parvenue : tu\lrefermes les ÉCHOS, l'un après
l'autre.\pSABRINA : Je les ai vus dans mes
visions bien avant que tu partes.\pBLAINE : Des bêtes, des golems, et
un qui voyage dans le temps. Quelle\lchasse !\pGIOVANNI : LÉO les écoute depuis
des années. T'es celui qui répond.\pTiens. Un cadeau de la vieille
garde.

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Interlud.en:
LANCE: A dragon's trust is earned,
never commanded. The boss forgot.\pAGATHA: He does not crave power for
its own sake. He wants to be heard.\pBRUNO: And he believes the strong
must speak for the weak.\pWILL: I read the old books. The AURA
is not a weapon. It is a cry.\pWhatever you wished for, CHAMPION,
you already proved him wrong.
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Interlud.fr:
PETER : La confiance d'un dragon se
mérite, s'ordonne jamais. Le\lboss l'a oublié.\pAGATHA : Il convoite pas le
pouvoir pour lui-même. Il veut être\lentendu.\pBRUNO : Et il croit que les forts
doivent parler pour les faibles.\pWILL : J'ai lu les vieux livres.
L'AURA est pas une arme. C'est un\lcri.\pQuel que soit ton vœu, CHAMPION, tu
lui as déjà prouvé qu'il avait\ltort.

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Interlud.en:
KOGA: His followers have nothing.
That is why they follow.\pKAREN: Darkness is not evil. But a
heart that hides from it is lost.\pSIDNEY: Ha! Fifteen fights, and
this one is still smiling!\pPHOEBE: Four left. The sea is calm,
but something stirs far away.\pKeep going. We will wait.
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Interlud.fr:
KOGA : Ses partisans ont rien.
C'est pour ça qu'ils le suivent.\pKAREN : L'obscurité est pas le
mal. Mais un cœur qui s'en cache\lest perdu.\pSIDNEY : Ha ! Quinze combats, et
celui-ci sourit encore !\pPHOEBE : Il en reste quatre. La mer
est calme, mais quelque chose remue\lau loin.\pContinue. On attendra.

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Intro.en:
THE GRAND FINAL.\pI am LORELEI, the ELITE FOUR's
first guard, and this year's wild\pcard.\pNo one outlasts me when it comes
to icy POKéMON.\pThe crowd is waiting. Are you
ready?{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Intro.fr: LA GRANDE FINALE.\pJe suis LORELEI, la première garde\ndu CONSEIL 4, et la wild card\lde cette année.\pPersonne ne me surpasse en matière\nde POKéMON de glace.\pLa foule attend. T'es prêt ?{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_NextElde.en: Well fought!\pThe next veteran steps forward.\nRecover your strength.
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_NextElde.fr: Bien combattu !\pLe prochain vétéran s'avance.\nReprends des forces.

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_NextMatc.en: Well fought!\pThe next match begins shortly.\nRecover your strength.
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_NextMatc.fr: Bien combattu !\pLe prochain match commence bientôt.\nReprends des forces.

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_PostBatt.en: You're better than I thought.\nGo on ahead.\pYou only got a taste of the\nPOKéMON LEAGUE's power.
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_PostBatt.fr: Tu sais te battre. Z'est bien.\pMais la LIGUE POKéMON te rézerve\nd'autres zurprizes !

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_RematchI.en:
Welcome to the POKéMON LEAGUE.\pI, LORELEI of the ELITE FOUR,
have returned!\pYou know how it goes.
No one can best me when it comes\lto icy POKéMON.\pFreezing moves are powerful.\pYour POKéMON will be at my mercy
when they are frozen solid.\pHahaha!
Are you ready?{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_RematchI.fr:
Bienvenue à la LIGUE POKéMON.\pMoi, LORELEI du CONSEIL 4, je
suis de retour !\pTu connais la chanson. Personne ne
peut me battre avec des POKéMON de\lglace.\pLes attaques de gel sont
puissantes.\pTes POKéMON seront à ma merci quand
ils seront gelés.\pHahaha ! On y va ?{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Round0De.en: Remarkable! Your POKéMON have\ngrown so much!

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Round0In.en: POOL STAGE, MATCH 1 OF 5.\pPROF. SEKO: Even a professor enters\nthe LEAGUE!\pLet me see what you have learned\nfrom your journey!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Round0In.fr: PHASE DE POULE, MATCH 1 SUR 5.\pPROF. SEKO : Même un professeur\nentre dans la LIGUE !\pVoyons ce que t'as appris de ton\nvoyage !{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Round1De.en: Wow, you are strong!\nI will train even harder!
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Round1De.fr: Waouh, t'es fort ! Je vais\nm'entraîner encore plus dur !

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Round1In.en: POOL STAGE, MATCH 2 OF 5.\pMAY: Hi! I trained all the way from\nHOENN for this!\pI will not go easy on you!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Round1In.fr: PHASE DE POULE, MATCH 2 SUR 5.\pMAY : Salut ! Je me suis entraînée\ndepuis HOENN pour ça !\pJe te ferai pas de cadeau !{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Round2De.en: Not bad at all.\nYou earned that win.
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Round2De.fr: Pas mal du tout.\nTu as mérité cette victoire.

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Round2In.en: POOL STAGE, MATCH 3 OF 5.\pBRENDAN: So you are the one\neveryone is talking about.\pLet us see if the rumors are true!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Round2In.fr: PHASE DE POULE, MATCH 3 SUR 5.\pBRENDAN : Alors c'est toi dont tout\nle monde parle.\pVoyons si les rumeurs sont vraies !{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Round3De.en: Ha! That was a good one!

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Round3In.en: POOL STAGE, MATCH 4 OF 5.\pGOLD: Finally, a worthy opponent!\pMy partners and I have been\nwaiting for this.{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Round3In.fr: PHASE DE POULE, MATCH 4 SUR 5.\pGOLD : Enfin, un adversaire digne !\pMes partenaires et moi attendions\nça.{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Round4De.en: You are through.\nGood luck in the bracket!
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Round4De.fr: T'es qualifié.\nBonne chance dans le tableau !

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Round4In.en: POOL STAGE, MATCH 5 OF 5.\pCRYSTAL: Last match of the pool!\pI am not here to lose.\nLet us fight with two POKéMON\lat once!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Round4In.fr: PHASE DE POULE, MATCH 5 SUR 5.\pCRYSTAL : Dernier match de la\npoule !\pJe suis pas ici pour perdre.\nCombattons avec deux POKéMON à la\lfois !{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Round5De.en: I have no regrets.\nGo on ahead!

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Round5In.en: ROUND OF 16.\pLEAF: The bracket starts here.\pI have faced many TRAINERS, but\nI keep getting stronger.{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Round5In.fr: HUITIÈMES DE FINALE.\pLEAF : Le tableau commence ici.\pJ'ai affronté beaucoup de\nDRESSEURS, mais je deviens toujours\lplus forte.{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Round6In.en: QUARTER-FINAL.\p{RIVAL}: Well, well. You made it\nthis far.\pI will not let my rival beat me\nin front of this crowd!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Round6In.fr: QUART DE FINALE.\p{RIVAL} : Tiens, tiens. T'es\narrivé jusqu'ici.\pJe laisserai pas mon rival me\nbattre devant cette foule !{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Round7De.en: Hmph. Fine. You win this one.
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Round7De.fr: Hmph. Bon. Tu gagnes cette fois.

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Round7In.en: SEMI-FINAL.\pBLUE: Smell that? The air of the\nreal thing.\pI was CHAMPION once. Show me\nyou deserve more than that!\pTwo POKéMON each. Ready?{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Round7In.fr: DEMI-FINALE.\pBLUE : Tu sens ? L'air du grand\njour.\pJ'ai été CHAMPION un jour.\nMontre-moi que tu mérites plus que\lça !\pDeux POKéMON chacun. Prêt ?{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Round8De.en: Their voices... they chose you.\nI understand now.
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Round8De.fr: Leurs voix… ils t'ont choisi.\nJe comprends maintenant.

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Round8In.en: THE FINAL.\pN: I can hear your POKéMON.\pThey trust you. Yet are you\nsure they are truly happy?\pLet me hear their answer!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Round8In.fr: LA FINALE.\pN : J'entends tes POKéMON.\pIls te font confiance. Mais t'es\nsûr qu'ils sont vraiment heureux ?\pLaisse-moi entendre leur réponse !{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Tourname.en: The crowd roars!\pYou are the winner of the\nPOKéMON LEAGUE tournament!\pNow, the CHAMPION is waiting\nbeyond the door.
PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Tourname.fr: La foule rugit !\pTu es le vainqueur du tournoi de la\nLIGUE POKéMON !\pMaintenant, le CHAMPION t'attend\nderrière la porte.
